document_kind: Review-only Shopify Admin GraphQL definition variables; no Admin request has been executed.
status: Not applied to the store. Resolve reference GIDs and review existing definitions before any mutation.
content_entry_status_required: ACTIVE when publishable capability is enabled; enable storefront access for every definition.

reference_gid_replacements.REPLACE_WITH_GID_TA_VIE_PRODUCT_DETAIL: id returned for ta_vie_product_detail, e.g. gid://shopify/MetaobjectDefinition/...; do not use a fabricated ID.

read_only_review_query: query ReviewTaVieDefinitions { metaobjectDefinitions(first: 100) { nodes { id type name access { storefront } capabilities { publishable { enabled } } fieldDefinitions { key name required type { name } validations { name value } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } metafieldDefinitions(first: 100, ownerType: PRODUCT) { nodes { id namespace key name type { name } access { storefront } validations { name value } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
metaobject_definition_mutation: mutation CreateTaVieDefinition($definition: MetaobjectDefinitionCreateInput!) { metaobjectDefinitionCreate(definition: $definition) { metaobjectDefinition { id type name } userErrors { field message code } } }

runtime_guards: Every detail, scene and size row must have owner_product.value.id equal to current product.id.
Mismatches and empty public content are omitted; editor guidance is separate from public copy.
Liquid caps details at 6, scenes at 3, size_rows at 12 independently of Admin validation.
Do not assign the same feature or child entry to another product by changing its owner; create a separate entry.
review_notes: This JSON includes metadata and multiple operations; send only the selected operation string and its resolved variables to the Admin API.
If any type or ta_vie.feature already exists, compare it first. Do not delete or recreate existing definitions or values automatically.
The read query pageInfo must be followed for pagination; first 100 is not proof of no matching existing definition.
Confirm the supported Admin API version, permissions, file type and list validations with the store administrator. API userErrors must be checked; no live schema/application success is claimed.
No product assignments, entries, pictures, content or Admin credentials are embedded in this review artifact.
Create child definitions before the root; replace all REPLACE_WITH_GID tokens before submitting root or product metafield mutations.
Storefront access PUBLIC_READ is not equivalent to publishing the theme or publishing products. Publishable entries must separately be Active.
